topics.purpose: Define exact index build/update execution over source revision/cursor with completeness, lag and failure evidence.

semantics.identity_rule: Each index build/revision has explicit identity.
semantics.delete_rule: Source deletions/tombstones propagate according to explicit profile.
semantics.failure_rule: Partial index never masquerades as complete.
semantics.authority_rule: Index builder authority does not become source application authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.
